correctness.rationale: The two kernel moments satisfy the exact planar equations. Eliminating one moment gives a damped second-order equation with strict Lyapunov energy; coercivity and LaSalle force convergence to the three equilibria. The characteristic formula lifts moment convergence to \(L^1\). Strong cooperativity and the unordered saddle stable manifold give the unique threshold crossing.
residual_risks: Restricted to the stated two-stage class.

final_claim: For the explicit two-stage hypoexponential survival-weighted fertility class in the bistable Gurtin--MacCamy model, the PDE reduces to a damped cooperative planar system; every solution converges to an equilibrium and every nontrivial monotone-family threshold solution converges to the intermediate equilibrium.
limitations: Two-stage class only; higher-stage phase-type kernels remain open.
